Notes: PRO tools in Advanced: power and GPU driver check with the official driver page, support zip, export/import profile, What's new button. Game start note when a SI PRESET is ready or the PC is on battery. Steam launch option copied after a preset that needs it. Thumbs up/down on applied presets. Command line: -ListPresets, -Preset <id>, -UndoPreset <id>, -Silent.

Riga di comando: -ListPresets, -Preset <id>, -UndoPreset <id>, -Silent.
